status: first pass (roadmap R6 and E9, docs/EM_ARCHITECTURE.md section 27)
notes: Representative clutter heights for the far ground's towns the map does not lay out (simcore/terrain_map.hpp MapData::ObstacleHeight, read by LoadMap): a line of sight or a radio path over such a town carries this height on the ground, as ITU-R P.1812 adds its representative clutter heights to the path profile. A town's middle (within dense_share of its radius) is dense urban, the rest suburban; a village is suburban throughout. Where the map lays a town out (the map proper's and the detail areas' towns) its buildings are the obstacles instead.
source: itu_r_p1812 (its table of default representative clutter heights); the share of the radius is a game value

dense_share.source: game value: the same share of the radius as the map's towns lay blocks of flats in (terrain_map.hpp LaySettlement, a city)
